meta.title: Skills Market
meta.description: Search skills.sh, preview every file and safety warning, then install community agent skills into ~/.dsh/skills and manage them from one panel.

title: Skills Market
intro: Search skills.sh or a custom market source and install community skills locally. Descriptions and code are third-party; review the preview before installing.
warningOffline: The skills catalog is unreachable, so popular skills are shown instead.
emptyResults: No skills match “{query}”. Try another keyword.
errorTitle: Could not load the skills catalog
errorBody: Check the network connection and try again.
previewWarningsHint: These patterns are common in third-party skills, but review each one. Click install again to continue.
previewNoWarnings: No suspicious command patterns were found.
previewExisting: A skill with the same name is already installed. Continuing replaces it (only skills managed by this plugin are replaced).
installedEmptyHint: Search the Discover tab to install your first skill.
trustBody: Catalog descriptions and skill code come from third parties. Confirm the source and review the preview before installing.
errorTimeout: The request timed out. Try again shortly.
errorFetch: Could not reach the remote service. Check the network and retry.
errorNotFound: This skill is not in the remote repository.
errorInvalidQuery: That search query is not valid.
errorInvalidSkill: The skill content is not valid, so it was not installed.
errorTooLarge: The skill is larger than the install limit.
errorExists: A skill with this name is already installed.
errorNotManaged: This skill was not installed by this plugin, so it cannot be removed automatically.
errorStagingExpired: The preview expired. Build a new preview.
warningQuery: The catalog did not accept that query, so popular skills are shown instead.
sourceDialogSubtitle: Search and install use the selected market source.
sourceBaseNote: A skills.sh-compatible base uses /api/search and /<owner>/<repo>/<skill> paths.
sourceIndexNote: A JSON index must declare format: 1. Skills are still downloaded from GitHub and go through preview and the safety scan.
errorSourceInvalid: A market source value is invalid.
errorSourceLimit: The market source limit has been reached.
errorSourceNotFound: That market source was not found.
errorSourceBuiltin: The built-in market source cannot be removed.
errorSourceFetch: The market source is unreachable. Check the URL or network.
errorSourceInvalidIndex: The JSON index format is invalid. Check format and fields.
